maddeler.e:
أتخاصم (form VI)
# أَتَخَاصَمُ (ʔataḵāṣamu) /ʔa.ta.xaː.sˤa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
# أَتَخَاصَمَ (ʔataḵāṣama) /ʔa.ta.xaː.sˤa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
# أَتَخَاصَمْ (ʔataḵāṣam) /ʔa.ta.xaː.sˤam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
